widgets_values:
Drive a LingBot World 2 world in real time from an image. Queue the prompt, then click the Reactor Realtime window and steer: W and S move forward and back, A and D strafe, Q and E orbit, and the arrow keys look around. Edit the prompt in that window and press Apply to change the weather, the light or what happens. Press Done to save the take under reactor/realtime, or Cancel to drop it.

LingBot World 2 prompt guide: https://docs.reactor.inc/model-api-reference/lingbot-world-2/prompt-guide

The prompt describes the image first, then a first-person camera moving through it, as the prompt guide sets out for a scene with no subject. When the prompt and the image disagree, the image wins. Copy example_inputs/reactor_city.png from this plugin into ComfyUI's input folder first. Set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.

widgets_values_named.text:
Drive a LingBot World 2 world in real time from an image. Queue the prompt, then click the Reactor Realtime window and steer: W and S move forward and back, A and D strafe, Q and E orbit, and the arrow keys look around. Edit the prompt in that window and press Apply to change the weather, the light or what happens. Press Done to save the take under reactor/realtime, or Cancel to drop it.

The prompt is the resting form the LingBot World 2 prompt guide gives for one fixed prompt: the world, then the camera, then the subject at rest. Copy example_inputs/reactor_jet_ski_cruise.jpg from this plugin into ComfyUI's input folder first. Set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.

widgets_values: A rain-soaked downtown street at night lined with glowing neon signs in red, green and blue, wet asphalt reflecting the lights, shopfronts and streetlamps on both sides. Moody cinematic neon-noir look. First-person view at street level moving straight down the centre of the road, the camera gliding forward at a steady pace as reflections slide across the wet asphalt.

widgets_values_named.model.prompt: A man in a red life vest on a white and red jet ski on turquoise water near a sandy beach lined with palm trees, a distant rocky outcrop on the horizon. Sunlit coastal atmosphere with light glinting off the calm sea. Strict third-person rear view, the man on the jet ski locked at the exact centre of the frame as the camera holds a fixed position behind him and tracks him forward.
